print_errors.note: Printed with final plain ه (no dots; checked at 900 dpi next to the dotted ة of «الشهادة»); p.021 prints the same word «ممضاة». Kept as printed.
«نحن نهني الأزهر» printed ن-ه-ن-ي without any hamza (expected نهنئ); checked at 600 dpi. Kept as printed.

The shadda+fatha is printed over the ع, not over the ر (checked at 2000 dpi: the mark sits above the ع body, the ر carries no mark); expected وَعَرَّفَهُ. Kept as printed: fatha on و, shadda+fatha on ع, nothing on ر, fatha on ف, damma on ه.
The second «سميرالصالحين» on the line is printed with no space (ink gap 7 px at 600 dpi vs 22 px for the first «سمير الصالحين» on the same line). Kept joined as printed.

notes: Markers: p.024 ends «…مع أنه كان ضنينًا جدًا» → p.025 «بالتقريظ…», so it is <<<ص:025+>>> (p.024 has no footnotes, so there is no (تابع)). p.025 ends «…لا يتأتيان إلا» → p.026 «من رجل…» = <<<ص:026+>>>. p.027 and p.028 each begin a new title in the list of works, so neither has a +. p.028 ends mid-sentence «ولما ذهبت إلى فاس أول مرة، صعب علي العلم،» (the line is justified, so it continues on p.029). No headings, footnotes, Quran or bold on pp.025-028. List of works (pp.026-028): each printed title line is its own paragraph, with no numbers or bullets printed. On p.026 the line «إقامة البرهان على نزول عيسى في آخر الزمان (طبع مرتين)» fills the line to the left margin, and the next line «وترجم إلى اللغة الأردية» is at the same list indent, so I treated it as a wrap of that item and joined it into one paragraph. On p.027 the third line holds two items on one printed line, «سمير الصالحين ج ١ (طبع مرتين) سميرالصالحين ج ٢ (طبع)», and is kept as one paragraph. Spacing there was measured from ink gaps at 600 dpi: ج|١ = 24 px and ج|٢ = 19 px against word spaces of 21-29 px on that line. On p.026, «حينئذ ٣٣ سنة» shows that digits carry only small bearings (٣|٣ = 8 px), so I wrote ج ١ / ج ٢ with a space. «ثلاث مرات» on p.027 line 1 has a normal space (23 px). Dashes on p.025 («منه – وكان … الشريعة – فهنأني») are en dashes with spaces, written as U+2013 as in earlier batches. ﷺ after «أخلاق النبي» on p.028 is the glyph U+FDFA. Printed harakat copied exactly: tanween fatha on the letter before the alif (مضافًا، وكيلًا، أيضًا، دويًا، كبيرًا، شيخًا، ردًا، كتابًا، شيئًا، حديثًا). Madda: رآني، القرآن، الآجرومية، آدم، الآمال، آخر. «علي» on pp.026 and 028 has no shadda. «اتحاف» on p.026 is printed with a bare alif (no hamza) and «المنتقاه» with a final ه; both checked at 800 dpi and kept as printed. The body font's automatic small alif on final ى is written as plain ى (على، إلى، عيسى، نادى، رأى، سوى، أخرى). «عبد الله» is printed with a space. Zooms are saved as scratch\a025_*, a026_*, a027_*, a028_*.
